about: AI polish test set (bench/suite.py polish): the original hand-written cases plus the hard ones from real dictations (the app's history, Oct 2026: long Chinese stammers, sentences cut up by stray periods, restarts, Traditional characters, noise words, spoken numbers, and kind `term`: speech-model mishearings that context makes clear, "Cloud Code" → Claude Code). Cases every model passed (≥95% over every run up to Oct 11, 2026) were dropped; they're in git history. `raw` is a transcript as the speech models write it (Apple: no punctuation; cloud: some). `expected` is the cleanup PolishService.instructions asks for: fillers and repeats gone, self-corrections resolved, light punctuation, wording otherwise kept. `must`: each entry must appear (alternatives split by |). `quick`: one of 20 cases for a fast run (--quick): mostly the ones models disagreed on, spread over languages and kinds. `must_not`: none may appear — fillers, the corrected-away value, and signs the model did what the dictation says (answered the question, wrote the email, translated) instead of cleaning it. Latin entries match whole words, case-insensitive; Chinese entries match as substrings.
